meta.question: What happened when he ﷺ was six years old?

data.answer: When the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ was six years old, his mother, Sayyidatuna Amina, took him to Madinah to visit his father's maternal relatives. On their journey back, she passed away in Abwa, a valley situated between Makkah and Madinah, and was buried there. This meant that the Prophet ﷺ, who had already lost his father, was now also deprived of his mother's love and care. His father's maidservant, Sayyidatuna Umm Ayman, comforted him during this difficult time.
